id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Helping Hand.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Helping Hand.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città, ho deciso di dare una mano insegnando la mossa Altruismo.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.
\rIl mio allenamento darà i suoi frutti.

id: \rMinimalism can be used to great use.
en: \rMinimalism can be used to great use.
it: \rIl minimalismo può essere usato con ottimi risultati.

id: \bHmmm... this Contest was something. But what was missing?
en: \bHmmm... this Contest was something. But what was missing?
it: \bMmm... questa Gara è stata notevole. Ma cosa mancava?

id: \rDawn: Hey \PN. I lost the Contest here. I'm so embarrassed. No need to worry though, I'm alright.
en: \rDawn: Hey \PN. I lost the Contest here. I'm so embarrassed. No need to worry though, I'm alright.
it: \rLucinda: Ehi, \PN. Ho perso la Gara qui. Che imbarazzo. Ma niente paura, sto bene.

id: \rHow did your Gym go? The Gym Leader is gone, huh?
en: \rHow did your Gym go? The Gym Leader is gone, huh?
it: \rCom'è andata in Palestra? Il Capopalestra non c'è, eh?

id: \rI have an idea! Why don't we enter the Battle Hall tournament? Let's see which of us can do better.
en: \rI have an idea! Why don't we enter the Battle Hall tournament? Let's see which of us can do better.
it: \rHo un'idea! Perché non partecipiamo al torneo del Sala Lotta? Vediamo chi di noi due se la cava meglio.
